just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Bb3 and dwells most on C in Gereyli. The line peaks at F4 (364.7 Hz) at 4:31.0. It closes on C3, not the tonic (C4 → C4 → C4 → C4 → G3 → C3).

flags: tonic G set in the catalog (Shur's finalis G (204.6 Hz; four of the suite's nine tracks voted it): from G the suite is Shur with its 5th lowered (0, 134, 286, 496, 627/703, 781, 990 cents). The vote picked the 4th above (C): with the 5th lowered the 4th sounds like a finalis (Farhat 1990, p. 27); read from C the 6th would be neutral (838 cents), which Shur's is not. Inference, not yet by ear); the runs' vote favoured 137.2 Hz (C)
